verdict.rationale: Slack's marketing pages explicitly claim AI-generated channel/thread summaries and daily recaps (slack-docs-15, slack-docs-13, slack-docs-14), but this is only vendor marketing copy with no hands-on or community confirmation of quality/reliability, and community evidence raises broader concerns about search/history limitations and paywalled message retention (slack-comm-10, slack-comm-15) that could undercut recap usefulness.
